meta.title: Guides: build with Fizlet, step by step · Fizlet
meta.description: Step-by-step Fizlet guides: build a micro game, fill an Astro slot with a scene, port a game onto the kernel and build your own lockstep room server.

head.lead: Each guide does one job end to end with real code: the APIs on the brick pages, the ideas in the docs.

cards.label: Build a micro game
cards.body: A 30-second click game on a canvas: typed-array state, a fixed step, pooled effects, a change-only HUD and Recall on Escape.

cards.label: Fill an Astro slot
cards.body: Fill an Astro page engine animation slot with a Fizlet scene: lazy, settles to zero frames, keeps the slot's text alternative.

cards.label: Port a game
cards.body: Hand an existing game loop to the kernel, one step at a time, with the size measured before and after.

cards.label: Your own room server
cards.body: The contract @fzlt/core/presence speaks: lockstep inputs, the 12-byte wire protocol, seats, the lobby, resume and the access check, plus the one-room-one-object pattern and a threat checklist.

map.note: Every module, its API and its size.
